name: Meta Ray-Ban Display
desc: AI glasses with an in-lens display and neural wristband
desc_zh: 带镜内显示屏和神经腕带的 AI 眼镜
solves: Checking a message meant pulling out the phone; a glance at the in-lens display shows it, and the wristband navigates.
solves_zh: 看条消息都要掏手机，现在瞥一眼镜内显示屏即可，腕带负责翻页操作。
best_for: You are cooking with messy hands and want the next recipe step shown in front of you.
best_for_zh: 做饭时双手沾满食材，想把下一步菜谱直接显示在眼前。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://about.fb.com/news/ (About Meta newsroom)）。 Outside the window. Announced 2025-09-18; on shelves 2025-09-30 (the year comes from the post's date); starts at $799 including Meta Neural Band. Different device from Ray-Ban Meta (no display) in the ledger. A plain HTTP client gets HTTP 400 from meta.com; the product page loaded through the fetch tool. 首次公开日期来源：https://about.fb.com/news/2025/09/meta-ray-ban-display-ai-glasses-emg-wristband/
